flags.sentence: La mandíbula inferior de este dinosaurio presentaba un frente sin dientes y en forma de costra que se asemeja a la estructura encontrada en los perezosos de dos dedos y en el perezoso terrestre extinto *Mylodon*.
flags.reason: The English text says 'front' (referring to the symphysis shape), but the Spanish translation says 'frente sin dientes' (toothless front), which incorrectly implies the entire front of the jaw is toothless rather than just the symphysis area, and 'forma de costra' (crust-like shape) is not supported by the quote 'scoop-shaped' (forma de cuchara).

flags.sentence: This genus is one of the three original groups used to define the entire Dinosauria clade, alongside Megalosaurus and Hylaeosaurus.
flags.reason: The sentence claims the genus is one of the three groups used to define the clade, but the quote specifies it is one of the three 'genera' (géneros), not groups.

flags.sentence: Este género es uno de los tres grupos originales utilizados para definir todo el clado Dinosauria, junto con *Megalosaurus* y *Hylaeosaurus*.
flags.reason: The Spanish sentence uses 'grupos' (groups) instead of 'géneros' (genera), changing the meaning from the specific taxonomic rank cited in the source.

flags.sentence: The massive size of the largest species allowed it to reach food growing 4 to 5 meters high in trees.
flags.reason: The sentence states the size 'allowed it to reach' (past fact), while the quote and fact state it 'would have allowed' (hypothetical inference), and the quote explicitly includes 'from the ground up', which the English sentence omits.

flags.sentence: La enorme talla de la especie más grande le permitió alcanzar alimentos que crecían a 4 o 5 metros de altura en los árboles.
flags.reason: The Spanish sentence uses 'le permitió' (past fact) instead of the hypothetical 'le habría permitido' found in the source quote, changing the certainty of the claim.

flags.sentence: However, iguanodontians in general are thought to have evolved alongside the rise of flowering plants during the Cretaceous.
flags.reason: The English sentence states they 'evolved alongside' the rise of flowering plants, but the quote only states they 'have been related to' the rise of angiosperms due to inferred habits; it does not confirm the specific evolutionary timing or co-evolution described in the sentence.

flags.sentence: Sin embargo, se piensa que los iguanodontianos en general evolucionaron junto con el auge de las plantas con flores durante el Cretácico.
flags.reason: The Spanish sentence uses 'evolucionaron junto con' (evolved alongside), which is a stronger claim of co-evolution than the quote's 'se han relacionado con' (have been related to), changing the meaning.

flags.sentence: Nuevos análisis indican que al menos tres eventos de alta mortalidad ocurrieron en un breve periodo de 10 a 100 años, aunque esto no prueba la vida en manada.
